messages:
maria_ops: Heads up — vendor (VendorX) pushed H250 allocation ETA from 2026-04-12 -> 2026-05-03 due to chassis shortage. This impacts Dedicated pool A (eu-west-1): 48/120 units delayed. Options: 1) expedite air at premium, 2) reallocate from us-west, 3) use refurbished top-ups. RMA angle: DOAs we planned to return next week could be used as swap stock if vendor agrees. PO 83721. Need decision by EOD.
ajay_procure: On it. Pinged our vendor contact (cc'd) for split ETA and expedite pricing. Preliminary air expedite +12–18% depending on slots. Reallocating has customs/freight cost — is that acceptable vs latency risk?
tony_logistics: If we pull from us-west transit ~72h + customs. Need EORI & updated insurance. For RMAs ask vendor for 'cross-apply' credit so returned DOAs offset replacements to avoid double shipments. If not, we can stage refurbished units (refurb pool: 30 units, 6 match thermal profile).
maria_ops: :eyes: Priority is keeping eu capacity for prod latency. How does this affect the 5/1 canary rollouts?
elaine_sre: Canary A (5/1) needs ~40 GPUs for steady-state tests. Losing 48 blocks canary. Options: reduce to 20 gpus + longer run, or run in us-west with simulated latency (~70ms). Need decision EOD to avoid blocking test plans.
ajay_procure: Vendor replied: can expedite 20 units by 2026-04-22 at +18%, rest by 2026-05-03. They can do swaps if RMA is raised within 7 days of delivery. I'll push for 30 unit expedite.
tony_logistics: Drafted carrier request — AWB 781-XY-332 (placeholder). Will update once vendor confirms. If expedite accepted we need PO amendment. @maria_ops want me to draft now?
maria_ops: Yes please. Also quick cost check: +18% delta — what's $$ impact for 30 units?
ajay_procure: Quick calc: base unit $12,000 -> +18% = +$2,160/unit -> 30 units =~ $64.8k. Add freight/insurance/duties ~ $8k => ~ $72.8k total delta. Will need finance approval.
elaine_sre: If we accept expedite, vendor must support swap-on-arrival so we avoid immediate return freight. Can vendor commit to swap-on-arrival?
tony_logistics: Vendor confirms swap-on-arrival for DOAs but requires serials, photos and signed acceptance. Depot needs to capture photos on receipt. I'll coordinate depot steps.
deploy-bot: RMA ticket created: RMA-2026-009 — https://infra.redwood/rma/RMA-2026-009
maria_ops: Ok proceed with PO amendment for 30-unit expedite. Tony: start photo manifest & reserve temp slots. Ajay: get swap-on-arrival in writing. Elaine: prepare degraded canary run plan as backup. Meeting 16:00 if we need exec escalation.
ajay_procure: Vendor legal looped in, asking earliest scan date for returns. Tony, can depot scan within 24h of arrival notice?
tony_logistics: Depot can scan within 24h of arrival notice and upload to RMA ticket. Reserved temp freight slots. :thumbsup:
maria_ops: One more — if vendor permanently raises price, keep new units for prod and use refurbished for non-prod. We'll finalize after RMA result.
ajay_procure: Noted. I'll push for written swap policy and PO amendment today.
maria_ops: Thanks, team.
